title: The number of terms in greedy Fibonacci-Lucas representations: paper, Lean 4 formalization and verification code
description:
Let a(n) be the number of terms in the greedy representation of n by the Fibonacci and Lucas numbers (OEIS A214973). The paper proves that a(1) + ... + a(n) = (1/5) n log_phi n + O(n), with explicit bounds |5T(x) - K(x) x| <= 19x and |5Z(x) - c K(x) x| <= 13x for the summatory functions, so that the ratio of the number of Zeckendorf summands of 1, ..., n to this sum tends to (5 - sqrt 5)/2. This settles Kimberling's conjecture (A214981; J. Integer Seq. 23 (2020), Article 20.9.5) that the limit exists and lies in (1.2, 1.4). It also proves Greathouse's conjecture that n first occurs in A214973 at (F_{3n+1} - 1)/2, and Kurkov's conjecture a(n) = A329320(A048679(n)).

paper/ holds the LaTeX source in the Fibonacci Quarterly template and the compiled PDF; dist/ holds the PDF, the LaTeX source zip, the arXiv tarball and MasterKimberlingFibonacciLucasZip.zip with every file of the repository. verification/lean/ is a Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the three theorems (6 files); its eight main theorems depend only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. verification/ also contains independent checks in C and C++ (n <= 10^8), Python (n <= 10^6, from the OEIS definitions), Julia (every lemma of the proofs) and Bash, and scripts/run_all.sh runs the Lean build, the axiom check and all programs.
